mapper.select: SELECT * FROM s_member WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE

SELECT member.id, member.account, member.mobile, member.nickname, member.avatar, member.gender, member.birthday, COALESCE(points.balance, 0) AS pointsBalance, COALESCE(points.total_earned, 0) AS totalPointsEarned, COALESCE(points.total_used, 0) AS totalPointsUsed, member.create_time AS createTime, member.update_time AS updateTime FROM s_member member LEFT JOIN s_member_points_account points ON points.member_id = member.id AND points.deleted = 0 WHERE member.deleted = 0
AND member.id = #{memberId}
AND ( member.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR member.account LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR member.mobile LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY member.create_time DESC
